HALO DESKTOP LIBMPV DEPENDENCY NOTICE

Halo Desktop's fetch script selects the baseline x64 LGPL libmpv developer
archive published by zhongfly/mpv-winbuild:

  https://github.com/zhongfly/mpv-winbuild

The build provider describes this archive as containing mpv under LGPL 2.1 or
later and statically linked FFmpeg under LGPL 3. The provider also publishes
the complete package list used to produce each build.

GNU LGPL 2.1 text:

  GNU-LGPL-2.1.txt

GNU LGPL 3 text:

  GNU-LGPL-3.0.txt

The generated external/mpv payload is ignored by Git and is not part of this
source repository. Redistribution of an application binary with libmpv must
include the notices and corresponding-source information required by the exact
libmpv build and all components it contains.
